summary: Update `brace-expansion` to address GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays)
Update `fast-uri` to address GHSA-7p8r-x3mc-p8w7 (Host Confusion via backslash authority introducer)
Update `golang.org/x/text` to v0.39.0 to address GO-2026-5970
Update `google.golang.org/grpc` to v1.82.1 to address GHSA-hrxh-6v49-42gf
Update `socket.io-parser` to address CVE-2026-69185 (Zero-attachment Memory Exhaustion)
Upgrade to use Go `1.26.5`. This resolves vulnerabilities
Agent: Fixed a denial-of-service vulnerability where `GET /v1/agent/connect/ca/roots`
Agent: Fixed a nil-pointer dereference panic in `ShadowServiceRouterConfigEntry.CheckEnt`
Agent: Fixed a security bypass where a user-supplied public listener
Agent: Fixed an unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability where
Agent: Fixed an unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability where the external gRPC
Ui: migrate yadda/Gherkin acceptance tests to native QUnit (harness, intentions/create, components, settings)

Xds: Add two new opt-in `ProxyDefaults.spec.config` keys for controlling the `server` response header on API Gateway HTTP listeners: `envoy_suppress_envoy_headers` (removes the header entirely) and `envoy_server_header_name` (renames it to a custom value). If both are set, suppress takes precedence
Agent: Stop logging the raw ACL token in debug-level content-type logs

Api-gateway: Fixed a regression that caused an HTTP API gateway to reject its configuration with an "inconsistent protocols" error (resulting in intermittent 503s) when a backend service's `service-router` composed a route to a destination in a different service, namespace, or partition during discovery-chain synthesis
Serf: Fix WAN flood-join to ignore non-alive destination members (leaving/left/failed), allowing rejoined servers to heal back to alive in WAN membership
Xds: Addition of XFCC headers to GPRC request similar to HTTP request for connect-proxy inbound listener
Plugin: The `DriverNetwork.Hash` method has been removed from the `plugin/drivers` package
Build: Update Go to v1.26.5
Checks: Nomad native service check IDs are now SHA256
Cli: add `-json-output` and `-t` flags to `nomad job plan` for structured plan output
Consul: Added the issuing Nomad client's node ID to the metadata of Consul tokens created via workload identity
Consul: Check IDs are now derived from SHA256 instead of SHA1
Jobspec: Removed the requirement that a variable validation `error_message` be a full English sentence, allowing messages written in any language
Planner: Added plan_apply_pipeline configuration that allows the leader to have more outstanding Raft writes when evaluating plans
Services: rendezvous hashes are now SHA256
Template: Add `run_on_first_render` option to `change_script` to execute scripts on the initial template render via the task Poststart lifecycle hook
Agent: Fixed a bug where the startup banner would display the wrong node ID for servers after restart
Api: Fixed a bug where the client allocation endpoints returned a 500 error instead of a 404 when the allocation's node could not be found
Auth: Fixed a bug where nodes could not sync allocations placed on them after being moved to a different node pool
Cli: Fixed a bug where `nomad operator root keyring remove` would not accept an abbreviated key ID
Client: Fix issue where deleted allocations may remain running
Client: Fixed a bug where a client could panic after an alloc is GC'd
Client: Fixed a bug where the client would not remount the secret and private tmpfs after a restart
Client: Fixed a bug where the previous allocation watcher would retry forever when the server returned a permanent error during data migration
Csi: Fixed a bug where evals blocked on missing CSI volumes would not unblock
Deployments: Fix garbage collection to respect threshold
Docker: Fixed a bug where tasks could execute outside of their assigned cpuset range
Drivers/java: Fixed a bug where the Java driver did not correctly decode the `work_dir` option
Jobspec: Fixed a bug where a negative `cores` value in a task's resource block was accepted during job validation and registration
Quota (Enterprise): Fixed a bug where disabling the use of cores in a quota would block the ability to use either cores or CPU in a job
Scheduler: Ensure deployment IDs are not written to an evaluation when the generated deployment is not persisted to state due to plan apply retries
Scheduler: Fixed a bug where the scheduler could panic with a nil pointer dereference when checking host volume feasibility for an allocation whose job had been purged
Secrets: Fixed hooks to allow refetch during prestart
Services: Fixed a bug where task secrets were not interpolated into service check `Header` and `Args`, or into service `Tags`
Ui: Fixed SSO sign in display not displaying when SSO enabled
Ui: Fixed a bug where the job status panel would show "Complete" instead of "Scaled Down" for system and sysbatch jobs with zero allocations
Ui: Fixed the region identifier header showing as empty in single region clusters
Ui: Fixed version diff display and missing deployment version numbers
Ui: check websocket upgrade headers with multiple values
Ui: refetch nomad license when logging in with new token
